text:
Situation: Ceftriaxone sodium 1 g injection inventory varies across sites. Corvale Lakeside holds 37 vials with 8.8 days on hand. Corvale East holds 253 vials with 19.6 days on hand. Corvale General holds 298 vials with 18.9 days on hand. Corvale General also holds 287 vials of the 2 g presentation with 18 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows ceftriaxone sodium is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: No national shortage exists per FDA records. The risk is localized to Corvale Lakeside where supply falls below two weeks. Internal redistribution can resolve the imbalance without external purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 22 vials of 1 g injection from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. If Corvale East cannot release stock, transfer 22 vials of 1 g injection from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
3. Monitor daily use at all three sites and re-evaluate in seven days. Approval: Pharmacy Buyer.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Civica, Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, or Sandoz Inc. at this time because the drug is not on FDA's shortage list and internal supply is sufficient to cover the gap.
